On Tue, Mar 10, 2027 at 09:38 AM ben_carter@redwood.ai wrote:
> Ben: Karthik, can you validate whether the invite link contains a relaystate/tenant override...

Quick technical update: we’re seeing the SAML assertion NameID formatted as "emily.ross@halcyonhealth.com" but the assertion also contains a tenant alias (halcyon-global) in the Issuer element. Our tenant-resolution logic uses the alias when present which is causing the request to bind to the older Halcyon Global org. That explains the "account already claimed" message.

I attached a redacted snippet of the assertion (saml-assertion-snippet.txt). Two options:
1) Short-term: issue a manual invite link that includes ?force_tenant=halcyon-health and a single-use token (I can generate now).
2) Longer-term: change the tenant-resolution priority to prefer exact org-name claim over issuer alias — engineering will need a small config change, ETA ~48 hours.

Marissa, please approve the manual invite if we want to proceed immediately. Emily, if you can accept within the hour once I send the manual link that’ll unblock PO processing.

— Karthik

Emily — quick follow-up. We pushed the manual invite token this morning and I confirmed acceptance from your email address.

Summary/closure:
- Root cause: tenant alias in SAML Issuer -> routed to legacy Halcyon Global tenant.
- Immediate fix: Karthik issued a one-time invite with force_tenant parameter; Emily accepted successfully (confirmed).
- Follow-up: engineering will update tenant-resolution priority to prefer org claim over issuer alias (target: 48 hours).

Action items for AP: you should now see the vendor record and the PO visibility field in the portal. If anything still looks off (missing tax fields or W9), reply here and we’ll escalate to onboarding ops.

Thanks for patience and apologies for the inconvenience — will follow up once the config change is live.
